def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    # The bottom-row nonzero run is the sequence template.
    seq = [v for v in grid[-1] if v]
    for r in range(1, h-1):
        for c, color in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if color in seq:
                start = c - seq.index(color)
                for i, v in enumerate(seq):
                    x = start + i
                    if 0 <= x < w:
                        out[r][x] = v
    return out

def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    seq = [v for v in grid[-1] if v]
    # Demo suggests each isolated marker takes the periodic sequence, aligned
    # so the matching sequence element remains at the marker's position.
    for r in range(1, h - 1):
        for c, color in enumerate(grid[r]):
            if color in seq:
                phase = seq.index(color)
                for x in range(w):
                    out[r][x] = seq[(x - c + phase) % len(seq)]
    return out
